title: Tag Validator
goal: Decide whether markup is exactly one valid root tag containing properly nested content.
strategy: A stack tracks open tag names. Ordinary text and CDATA are allowed only inside the root. Closing tags must match the stack top, and once the root closes no additional content may follow.

edgeCases: A closing tag cannot skip the most recent opening tag
A second complete root is still invalid
An unterminated CDATA section never becomes ordinary text
inputRules: The input parser enforces the problem domain and explicit limits for an inspectable trace.
